market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~7k on May 1, 2026 after correcting ~50% from 26k Oct 2025 peak; Feb 2026 lows were ~3k. To resolve YES, any 1-min candle must touch <=5k by Dec 31, 2026 (~42% further drop). 8 months remaining; possible in a deep bear continuation but base-rate for such a fall in 8 months is modest.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro/crypto liquidity deteriorates further or BTC stabilizes.
